title: Alanis Morissette Talks Musical Journey, Postpartum, and More on ‘Call Her Daddy’
summary: The singer-songwriter sits down with Alex Cooper to also discuss her career, lesbian kiss with Carrie Bradshaw, and more.
body_markdown:
[Alanis Morissette](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/alanis-morissette) is getting into the holiday spirit with new original music — and a collaboration with Martin Short.

During a new episode of of *Call Her Daddy* with[Alex Cooper](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/alex-cooper) , talks about holiday music, plus starting her career at a young age and finding her voice in a male-dominated music industry.


She also opens up about pushing against the expectations placed on women, being labeled “too much,” and how the anger and honesty of her music made her a defining voice of the ’90s. Additionally, Alanis discusses navigating love and breaking patterns of codependency, her experience with postpartum depression, and the freedom and complete metamorphosis that comes with getting older.


### Alanis Morissette Details New Christmas Songs


During a new episode of of *Call Her Daddy* with[Alex Cooper](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/alex-cooper) , Alanis shared new details about her upcoming holiday album. The legendary singer-songwriter said the album grew out of recording a holiday song each Christmas over the past several years.


“As they were accumulating, and I love them so much, I love singing these songs,” Alanis said. “I wrote a couple of new songs and we just made a record.”


Those originals are titled “To an Empathic Christmas Time” and “Christmas on the Dance Floor.” Alanis called the album a “labor of Christmas love.”


### Alanis Morissette Teases Martin Short Collaboration


Alanis also revealed that she and Martin Short are teaming up for a Judy Garland song on the album.


She added that her favorite holiday classics to sing include “What Child Is This?” and “Little Drummer Boy.”


### Alanis Morissette Reveals Story Behind *Sex and the City* Kiss With Carrie Bradshaw


During the episode, Alanis also got candid about suggesting Carrie Bradshaw’s lesbian moment on *Sex and the City* .
